provenance.builtDuring: Phase 3.8.1 (Service Replay Intelligence + Professional Live-Service Operator Workspace) - rebuilt to package the fixed transcript segmentation (bounded chunking + optional timestamp-cue parsing) and the real-time Bible/Sermon/Attention/Presentation display now mounted on the Service Replay screen
provenance.buildEnvironment: cross-compiled from Linux using rustup target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu, gcc-mingw-w64, and nsis (makensis) - identical toolchain to every prior phase, see docs/phase-3-4-windows-pilot.md for the original toolchain setup and docs/phase-3-8-1-service-replay-intelligence.md for what changed this phase
provenance.note: This artifact supersedes the Phase 3.8 installer (previously SHA-256 4f1a1890d10584c37424a71cfe1e664829c76c40adeafba0aef06a355d891ac4) because this phase rewrote apps/desktop/src/components/servicereplay/replay.ts's segmentation algorithm (fixing the reported 2-segment collapse on a real ~52-minute transcript) and apps/desktop/src/components/servicereplay/ServiceReplay.tsx (mounting the same commands.list*/liveEvents.on* read model and WorkspaceHeader/SystemStatusStrip/AttentionQueue/IntelligenceFeed/PresentationCard components LiveChurchBrain.tsx already used, so the operator sees real Bible/Sermon/Attention/Presentation activity while a replay runs). Zero backend changes (no new Tauri command, no new migration, no new intelligence engine - see docs/phase-3-8-1-audit.md for why none was justified). This is a freshly compiled build (`cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` via `tauri build`), not a copy of a prior artifact.

releaseCandidateStatement: This is the Phase 3.8.1 SOFTWARE RELEASE CANDIDATE for Windows x64 (Service Replay Intelligence + Professional Live-Service Operator Workspace). It is a real, verifiable build artifact - not a placeholder, not a simulation, not a fabrication. See docs/phase-3-8-1-service-replay-intelligence.md for the full PASS/HOLD breakdown and final gate.
physicalHardwareStatement: Physical hardware qualification has NOT been performed in the build environment. This installer has not been installed, launched, or tested on any real Windows machine. No real microphone, no real Whisper transcription, no real second display/projector, and no real human operator workflow has been exercised against this build. Xvfb, simulated audio, virtual displays, automated tests, Service Replay, and cross-compilation success are Environment A/B evidence only and are never substituted for Environment C (real hardware) evidence anywhere in this project's documentation. The user's own prior Windows testing (which reported the defects this phase fixes) is real Environment C usage of the PRIOR (Phase 3.8) build, not of this rebuilt artifact - this artifact itself has not yet been tested on that hardware.
githubReleaseStatus: NOT CONFIGURED - no .github/workflows directory exists in this repository, and no GitHub Release has been created for this artifact. This installer is available only via this repository's working tree (release/windows/), not via GitHub Releases or any CI/CD pipeline.
obtainingWithoutDeveloperTooling: The file at release/windows/Church Intelligence Platform_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe can be copied/transferred directly (e.g. via a git clone of this repository, a direct file download, or a USB drive) to the target Windows machine and run there. Running the installer on Windows requires none of: Claude Code, Rust, Cargo, Node.js, npm, or the CIP source tree - only the .exe file itself.
knownLimitations: UNSIGNED release candidate - Windows SmartScreen will show an 'unknown publisher' warning on first run
Cross-compiled from Linux, never launch-tested on real Windows hardware - Environment C remains not performed for THIS rebuilt artifact, consistent with every prior phase

Music Library is legitimately empty in a production build - no licensed production song dataset exists in this repository; Service Replay's default flow does not exercise Music Intelligence for this reason (the pre-existing Multi-Domain quick scenario still demonstrates it honestly, dev/test dataset only)

The ground-up visual/UX redesign described aspirationally in the Phase 3.8 spec (color language, responsive card layout, full Diagnostics-panel migration) was deliberately not attempted this phase either - only Service Replay's own real-intelligence display was added, reusing existing Live Service components verbatim
See docs/phase-3-8-1-service-replay-intelligence.md and pilot-evidence/3.8.1/ for the full Environment A/B/C evidence breakdown
